title: Language abroad during his European trip
summary: Brief talk about whether people spoke English on his trip; most did except cab drivers.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe

blocks.x: You know, we ought to at least learn, we ought to learn at least some, you know, some language. Because it's terrible. You mean everybody, everybody spoke English when you were over there? I mean, two of you said, you know, when they talked with you?
Well, yeah, not everybody. But most of the people you met spoke English? Of course.
Yeah, the ones that were coming in contact with me, they, you know, spoke some, all but the cab drivers. Oh, yeah, yeah, yeah. Hotels.
